purpose: In-place technical issue markers and reversible preview-only fixes
routeConvention: All route fields are paths relative to the Justin preview document base; integration supplies that base. Do not use the public production origin as a mutation target.
inspectionMethod: Read-only parsing of the actual assembled preview HTML; selectors derive from inspected elements and match counts were verified with equivalent DOM paths. Runtime CSS/rendering not rechecked in this mapping pass.
guardrails: Markers may be placed on a visible ancestor when the issue target is hidden
Check expectedMatchCount and textGuard against the current preview DOM before applying an option; stop on mismatch
Changes stay inside an isolated preview until explicitly exported or accepted
Do not submit forms, contact anyone, or publish to the production campaign site
Preserve campaign text, policy positions, links, and audience scope except the explicit technical token cleanup or requested form-disclosure prototype
